wywf.config.title: What You Want To Find
wywf.config.general.language.name: Language
wywf.config.general.language.desc:
What language your search words are understood in.

EN - English only
RU - Russian only
AUTO - both languages at once
(all words from both files work)

If you type Russian words and they are not
found - check this setting.

Default: EN.
wywf.config.general.performance.name: Performance
wywf.config.general.performance.desc:
How much of your processor the search may use.

AUTO - picks a sensible share (~65%)
ECONOMY - quiet mode, game stays smooth
HIGH - faster, game may stutter a bit
MAX - everything, fastest search

Default: AUTO.
wywf.config.search.scan.name: Scan area
wywf.config.search.scan.structure_radius:
How far from the search center to look for
structures: villages, temples, mansions and so on.

Bigger = finds structures farther away,
but each search takes longer.

Default: 40 chunks = 640 blocks.
wywf.config.search.scan.biome_radius.des:
How far from the search center to look for
biomes: forest, desert, mushroom island...

Make this bigger if you want a biome that can
spawn far away. Bigger = slower searches.

Default: 16 chunks = 256 blocks.
wywf.config.search.scan.biome_step.desc:
How densely biomes are checked.

Smaller number = fewer missed biomes,
but slower searching.

1 - very thorough (slow)
4 - good balance (recommended)
8 - fast but may miss small biomes

Default: 4.
wywf.config.search.center.name: Search center
wywf.config.search.center.desc:
The point distances are measured from.

SPAWN - near where YOU will appear.
Use this for 'in mushroom', 'near village':
you want things around YOUR spawn point.

ORIGIN - near map corner (0, 0).
For when you plan to travel there first.

BOTH - accepts either of the two.
Careful: a match may sit at (0, 0) while
your actual spawn is hundreds of blocks away.
wywf.config.search.limits.name: Limits
wywf.config.search.limits.desc: Safety limits so a rare query cannot run forever.
wywf.config.search.limits.time.desc:
Maximum search time.
When time runs out, search stops and shows
found results.

Minimum: 5 minutes. Default: 30 minutes.
wywf.config.search.limits.infinite.desc:
When ON, seed limit is ignored — search runs
until time limit or candidates found.

Max seeds setting is disabled.
Default: OFF.
wywf.config.search.limits.max_seeds.desc:
Maximum number of seeds to evaluate.
Search stops when reached.
Disabled when 'Infinite seeds' is ON.

1M = 1,000,000
10M = 10,000,000 (default)
1B = 1,000,000,000

Range: 1M — 1B. Default: 10M.
wywf.config.search.candidates.name: Candidates
wywf.config.search.candidates.collect.de:
How many matching seeds to collect before
stopping the search.

More = better choice, longer wait.
The winner is picked by your ranking mode
(see 'Sort by distance').

Default: 8.
wywf.config.search.candidates.stop_first:
When ON, the search ends the moment ONE matching
seed is found - fastest possible result, but no
alternatives are collected.

Overrides 'Candidates to collect'.

Default: OFF.
wywf.config.search.candidates.linear.des:
Special mode for biome-only queries with center ORIGIN:
walks seeds in order 0, +1, -1, +2... so tiny memorable
seeds like 42 or -39 appear first.

Slower than the default method for hard queries.
Does nothing for structure queries or SPAWN center.

Default: OFF.
wywf.config.search.candidates.sort_dista:
How the winner is chosen from verified candidates.

OFF (soft): best overall match wins - every
condition counts (biomes AND structures AND spawn).

ON (strict): closest structure wins - other
conditions only break ties.

Either way, every candidate is fully re-verified
first; failing ones are discarded.

Default: OFF (soft).
wywf.config.general.native.name: Native acceleration
wywf.config.general.native.desc:
Controls how the native cubiomes library is used.

AUTO: use native if DLL loaded, Java fallback otherwise.
NATIVE: require native DLL — error if not available.
CLASSIC: Java-only, no native acceleration.

Native is faster for biome/structure checks.
Default: AUTO.
wywf.config.general.performance.manual_t:
Set the exact number of search threads yourself.
0 = follow Thread mode above.

More threads = faster search, but Minecraft
may stutter while searching.

Default: 0.
wywf.config.search.center.random_start.d:
When ON, each new search starts from a random spot
in the seed space, so repeated searches show
different worlds.

Turn OFF for repeatable, comparable searches.

Default: ON.
